title: PNB Salary Rupay Platinum credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The PNB Salary credit card from Punjab National Bank is a salary-linked card designed for salaried professionals, offering basic reward benefits, flexible credit limits aligned with income, and secure domestic and international transaction support.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Personal Assistance, anytime, anywhere 24*7 in Hindi, English, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi and 4 south Indian languages

benefitRows.name: Health Check-up
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary Health Check-up, once per annum.
